verdict.rationale: Zulip's topic model is explicitly designed so that side conversations in a channel each get their own topic/thread, keeping related messages together (zulip-docs-1, zulip-docs-16, zulip-docs-21/26, zulip-docs-29), and community users independently confirm this threading is the standout feature ('the killer feature'; 'most important feature of Zulip is threading') that lets side discussions stay separated without interrupting the main flow (zulip-comm-5, zulip-comm-15, zulip-comm-20). Missing for 10: a first-party doc specifically titled around 'replying within a topic' (docs focus on starting new topics) and independent screenshots/hands-on demo of replying into an existing thread rather than just topic creation.
